name: demoreel
description: Turn CS2 demos into match stats, highlight clips and videos: a skill that teaches the agent demoreel, plus a connection to its MCP server (by default a local `uv run demoreel serve` at http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp; the address and key are asked on install).

mcp_url.title: demoreel MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: The /mcp address of your demoreel server. Keep the default for a local `uv run demoreel serve`.

api_key.title: demoreel key
api_key.description: The server's DEMOREEL_ADMIN_KEY (or DEMOREEL_API_KEY when it has no admin key). Leave empty for a server without a key.
